name: convco
description: convco — conventional commits CLI. Generate changelogs, bump versions, validate commit messages per Conventional Commits spec.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/convco/convco/releases/download/v0.6.2/convco-linux-x86_64-musl.tar.gz && tar xzf convco-linux-x86_64-musl.tar.gz && sudo mv convco /usr/local/bin/ && rm convco-linux-x86_64-musl.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo install.

commands.description: convco — conventional commits CLI. Generate changelogs, bump versions, validate commit messages per Conventional Commits spec.
